map.通过逐级递增负荷测试记录心率与血乳酸，拟合曲线后在血乳酸 ≈ 4 mmol/L: Record heart rate and blood lactate during a graded incremental-load test, fit a curve, then read the lactate-threshold heart rate at blood lactate ≈ 4 mmol/L to partition endurance training intensity zones.
map.乳酸阈值（LT）是血乳酸开始非线性累积的拐点，常用: The lactate threshold (LT) is the inflection point where blood lactate begins to accumulate non-linearly; commonly
map.对应强度作为阈值；在逐级负荷曲线上该点的心率即乳酸阈心率。: the corresponding intensity is taken as the threshold; the heart rate at that point on the graded-load curve is the lactate-threshold heart rate.
map.按递增负荷（如每级 3–4 分钟）记录心率与血乳酸。: Record heart rate and blood lactate at increasing loads (e.g., 3–4 min per stage).
map.输入各级数据。: Enter the data for each stage.
map.结果区显示拟合曲线与乳酸阈心率。: The result area shows the fitted curve and the lactate-threshold heart rate.
map.阈值强度是耐力训练的核心区间。: Threshold intensity is the core zone for endurance training.
map.阈值心率以上为无氧/高强度区间。: Above the threshold heart rate lies the anaerobic/high-intensity zone.
map.需采血或佩戴无创乳酸设备；不同实验室阈值定义（2/4 mmol/L）略有差异，纵: Requires blood sampling or a non-invasive lactate device; threshold definitions differ slightly across labs (2/4 mmol/L), so fix the standard for longitudinal comparison.
map.乳酸阈和通气阈一样吗？: Is lactate threshold the same as ventilatory threshold?
map.相关但不等同；通气阈是无创估算，乳酸阈更直接但需采血。: Related but not identical; the ventilatory threshold is a non-invasive estimate, while the lactate threshold is more direct but requires blood sampling.
map.多久测一次？: How often should it be measured?
map.训练周期关键节点（如周期初/中/末）测，观察阈值心率变化。: Measure at key points of a training cycle (e.g., start/middle/end) to observe threshold-heart-rate changes.
